item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00725","case1_error":"Reports one shortened component’s length, 5 inches, instead of the three-piece assembly’s length, 15 inches.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 18 + 6 + 8 + 7 as 49 instead of 39.","reason":"Case 1 answers the component length instead of the combined length; case 2 numerically miscalculates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00726","case1_error":"Divides days by remaining words, reversing the ratio needed for words per day.","case2_error":"Treats all four dogs’ combined daily consumption as each dog’s consumption, counting the four dogs twice.","reason":"The first reverses a rate’s numerator and denominator; the second reuses an aggregate as a per-dog amount.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00727","case1_error":"Uses 12 cups per set instead of 24, omitting the two-dozen multiplier.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, mislabeling 15 batches as 15 servings and then computing 7.5 batches.","reason":"The first omits a required conversion factor; the second applies a conversion twice.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00728","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 19 after describing a method that yields 17.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 29 after correctly writing 65 − (22 + 24), which yields 19.","reason":"Both append an incorrect final number to an otherwise correct method without showing the numerical calculation that produced it.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00729","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 12000 after correctly specifying 3000 + 276 × 48 + 7000, which yields 23248.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 2500 after correctly describing calculations yielding 4500 pages.","reason":"Both present correct formulas or relationships followed by an unsupported incorrect final number; neither shows an erroneous numerical evaluation.","judgment":"same"}]}
